annotations.title: Base64 decode: decode base64 or URL-safe base64 back to text

description: Decode standard or URL-safe base64 to UTF-8 text. Missing padding is tolerated. Use to read encoded headers, tokens and data URLs. Example: text=aGVsbG8gd29ybGQ=. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
